note: The board suite's fixed play list (tools/hearth/board_suite.py, planning/esp32-platform-profiles.md, 'The board suite'). A stream is a file of the repository that the suite serves to the board and plays over POST /play; a profile's plays are the rows it is held to, in order. The figures a row is held to are recorded per profile in baselines/<profile>.json by `board_suite.py run --record`. A new feature is a new row here and a new figure there, in the same PR.

tolerance.note: From ten plays a row on S3b (the s3-n16r8 image, 2026-10-12): the decoder 122 to 124 permille of a frame for AC-3 2.0 and 87 to 90 for E-AC-3 2.0, the decode stack 18,076 to 18,256 bytes free, the queue 5 ms, the boot largest block 31,744 and free RAM 86,231 to 86,235. A decoder time may be at most the baseline's plus the larger of 5% of it and 5 permille of a frame; the decode stack's free margin at most 512 bytes under the baseline's; the queue's least headroom at most 2 ms under; the boot largest internal block at most 1,024 bytes under and the boot free RAM at most 2,048 under. S3a is the cross-check, not yet run.

c6-16mb.note: The C6 refuses an HTTP play on purpose (CONFIG_ICLFORGE_EXAMPLE_PLAY_MIN_FREE_BYTES, #1395): its rows are that refusal, clean, with no reboot. Its audio path is Sendspin, which needs a server on the bench and is not in this list yet.
